$comment: Which Phosphor icons get compiled into the library, and at which weights.
Phosphor ships 1512 icons in six weights. Only what is listed here is
extracted into src/icons/generated.ts by scripts/build-icons.mjs, so the
package stays small and @phosphor-icons/core remains a devDependency that
never reaches a consumer's runtime.
Keys are our own stable semantic names. Values are Phosphor's file names.
The indirection is deliberate: renaming an icon upstream, or swapping which
glyph represents 'server', is then a one-line change here rather than a
find-and-replace across every component.
Weights are chosen per use, not generated wholesale:
regular  — all UI chrome. The default.
fill     — status marks, where a solid shape reads more decisively.
duotone  — the hero and section headers. Its rear path is recoloured to
the verdict tone, which is where the personality comes from.
Generating all six for everything would roughly double the output for glyphs
nothing renders.
A glyph with no enclosed area has no meaningful fill weight, and Phosphor
substitutes a different shape rather than a bolder outline. 'check-fill' is
a filled square CONTAINING a check, and 'spinner-fill' is a solid disc that
loses the spinner entirely — both would silently render the wrong icon.
That is why the filled pass mark is 'pass' (check-circle), which has a real
filled variant, and why bare 'check' and 'spinner' are regular-only.
Verify any new addition here by eye before trusting it.
